image: # Where each raw image of tools/venues/raw/ comes from (PixelLab, through its MCP server), so it can be made again.
# Made on 2026-11-22 and built by tools/make_venues.py.
# bg_<place>: create_image_pro, 640x360, opaque, one candidate; assets/sprites/venue/bg_cafe.png as the only reference image and as style
#   image. Every request began with the place "seen straight on, in exactly the style of the reference tavern interior" and ended with "The
#   middle of the room [...] is left plain and clear, for a character to stand there. No people, no text". Each was kept on the first try.
bg_bakery
what was asked: the inside of a medieval village bakery: two brick bread ovens with glowing embers against the back wall, wooden shelves loaded with round loaves, baguettes and brioches, wicker baskets of bread, sacks of flour, a peel leaning on the wall, a long wooden counter across the lower third of the image with a few loaves on its ends, timber beams and hanging lanterns, morning light from a leaded window on the left

image: bg_barracks
what was asked: the drill yard of a medieval village barracks: packed-earth ground, straw training dummies on posts, a rack of spears and a rack of round shields, two archery targets, a stone barracks wall with an arched door and blue and gold banners behind, a wooden palisade, clear late-afternoon light. A low wooden fence rail runs across the lower third of the image like a counter

image: bg_lodge
what was asked: the workshop of a medieval master builders' lodge: a large drawing table across the lower third of the image, with building plans, scrolls, an inkwell and a small wooden model of a house on its ends; shelves with scale models of houses and a cathedral; set squares, compasses and plumb lines hanging on the wall; a few cut stone blocks and a mason's mallet; a leaded window on the left looking onto a wooden scaffold; timber beams and hanging lanterns

image: # char_<keeper>: create_image_pro, 160x160, no background, 4 candidates. Reference images: the first frame of the keeper's 64x64 portrait
#   (assets/sprites/portraits/<keeper>.png: "who she is: the same woman, same face, same clothes, drawn bigger") and the first frame of
#   assets/sprites/venue/char_merchant.png ("framing, size on the canvas and drawing style only"), the latter as style image too. Every request
#   began with "half-body character of a medieval village game, in exactly the style and framing of the style image (a keeper seen from the
#   waist up, facing the viewer, cut at the waist by the bottom edge, bold dark outline, two-tone shading):".
char_baker
what was asked: Mélisande the baker, the woman of the portrait reference with the same round kind face and the same smile, a white baker's cap over light brown hair, a cream blouse with rolled sleeves and a white apron, holding a big golden round loaf in both hands in front of her

image: char_captain
what was asked: Captain Hilde of the village guard, the woman of the portrait reference with the same stern face and the same thin scar on her cheek, auburn hair tied back, polished steel plate armour with a blue sash across the chest, arms crossed, the hilt of a sword at her hip

image: char_guide
what was asked: Aveline the master builder, the woman of the portrait reference with the same cheerful face, auburn hair in a bun held by a pencil, a green shirt with rolled sleeves under a brown leather apron, a rolled building plan in one hand, a bright open smile

image: # char_<keeper>/frame_001..008: animate_image on the candidate kept, 8 frames, the candidate given as first and last frame so the loop closes.
#   The job returns nine images (0: the candidate, 1 to 8: drawn); images 1 to 8 are frame_001 to frame_008, in order. Each motion asks for
#   a glad face and a cross one on the way, which the game holds for a moment after a good or a bad move (data/venues.js `faces`).
char_baker anim
what was asked: standing still behind a counter, breathing gently, shoulders rising slightly; she smiles wider with a happy little laugh, blinks once, then for a moment raises her eyebrows with a small worried frown, then returns to her warm smile. The loaf and the hands stay in place, the head stays in place

image: char_captain anim
what was asked: standing still at attention, breathing slowly, shoulders rising slightly; she gives a short approving nod with a faint proud smile, blinks once, then for a moment frowns sternly with lowered brows, then returns to her calm steady look. The armour and the arms stay in place, the head stays in place

image: char_guide anim
what was asked: standing still, breathing gently, shoulders rising slightly; she laughs brightly with her eyes closed for a moment, blinks, then for a moment winces with a small doubtful grimace and raised eyebrows, then returns to her cheerful smile. The rolled plan and the hands stay in place, the head stays in place
